differences: The Figma frame includes OS-owned desktop wallpaper and menu-bar pixels; the durable implementation captures isolate the two PID-owned native popup windows instead of redrawing system chrome.
The durable native captures are 2x host pixels while Figma's reference export is 1x; recorded point bounds are identical.
reasoning: The live AppKit popup windows match the Figma main-menu and unavailable-readings-menu bounds exactly (230x187pt and 250x176pt), with matching row order, native light material, hover/chevron, checkmark, disabled Components state, separators and keyboard shortcuts. The app-owned captures contain no custom menu painting. The current host cannot provide the system compositor's status-bar wallpaper pixels, so those OS-owned pixels are intentionally excluded rather than approximated.

native_capture.accessibility: No AX or TCC request; native semantics remain AppKit-owned
